static_traits.name: Liu Xinyi
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, close relationship with parents
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but has not yet discussed this specific issue with them; Relationship with friends affected due to frequently canceling early-morning activities
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems or psychotherapy history in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, cooperative, neutral emotional tone; able to describe trigger situations and feelings concretely; uses catastrophic and black-and-white language like 'will ruin the whole weekend'; able to accept suggestions and make concrete plans; no signs of thought disorder yet.

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling extreme distress and Anxiety when needing to wake up early on weekends, believing it will ruin the whole weekend, thus avoiding all plans involving weekend mornings.
basic_info.core_demands: The distress and Anxiety related to weekend early rising have affected mental health and overall weekend enjoyment; hoping to relieve Anxiety through counseling, change the view that 'early rising = ruining the weekend', and Recover enjoyment of weekends.
growth_experiences: Months ago, needing to wake up early on a weekend morning for a very stressful photography event, the intense stress experience led to Significant anxiety about weekend early rising, gradually developing into avoiding all plans involving early mornings, causing interpersonal harm and Sleep patterns disrupted.

core_beliefs: I cannot cope well with the fatigue and discomfort brought by early rising
Once an unsatisfying part appears on the weekend, the whole is ruined

special_situations.event: On Sunday mornings, needs to get up early for photography activities or handle affairs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I need to get up early on the weekend, I will be tired and irritable all day and the whole weekend will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding scheduling any plans involving weekend early mornings; trying relaxation and distraction to reduce Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I get up early on the weekend, the weekend is ruined.

special_situations.event: A friend proposes a weekend activity invitation requiring early-morning gathering
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If sleep is not enough, I cannot enjoy activities, will be in bad shape continuing through the whole weekend
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Canceling plans in advance, Avoids socializing invitations to avoid early rising
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From the moment I get up this morning my state will be poor, and the whole weekend is ruined.

special_situations.event: Going to bed the night before the weekend and thinking about getting up early the next day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as sleep is not good, the next day and the whole weekend will be a mess
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to relax and uses distraction methods to try hard to fall asleep
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot sleep now, tomorrow is ruined, and the weekend is ruined too.

special_situations.event: Reviewing past experiences related to getting up early
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a completely relaxing weekend counts as a good weekend
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on fatigue and negative cues, ignoring possible positive experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have never had a good experience from waking up early.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have relaxation and a sense of control on weekends, to enjoy rest and social activities calmly
core_conflict.fear: Fearing early rising causes persistent fatigue and Emotional loss of control, thereby ruining the whole weekend and affecting Interpersonal relationships
defense_goal: Maintains controllability and safety by avoiding any arrangements involving weekend mornings
Justifying cancellation and avoidance with the belief that 'getting up early = ruining the weekend'

object_relations.self_representation: An individual easily overwhelmed by fatigue, needing Self-protection
object_relations.object_representation: Friends' invitations are experienced as others bringing pressure and demands

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or others propose plans requiring early weekend-morning gatherings, or when the session focuses on the 'weekend early rising' topic
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating 'the discomfort of early rising' with 'the whole weekend being ruined', experiencing outside invitations as a threat to self-boundaries and control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declines or cancels in a polite but firm tone, emphasizing rational reasons such as 'need rest / worried it will affect my state', avoiding further exploration of emotional experience.

manifestations: Strongly desiring to arrange weekend rhythm and sleep autonomously, viewing early rising as deprivation of Freedom and rest (like event invitations, Work arrangements)
Maintains control over the weekend through avoidance
outcomes: Reduced weekend experience and Decreased quality of life

manifestations: Reduces contact with friends due to frequently canceling early-morning activities
Not yet disclosing the specific distress to friends

positive_force: Has a supportive circle of friends
Willing to try new coping strategies (such as behavioral experiments and written records)
Has planning and preparation ability (plans routes in advance, organizes equipment, arranges breakfast)
Stable occupational functioning (Work not yet affected)
Interest in and engagement with photography can be converted into positive motivation to get up early
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking (early rising = ruining the whole weekend)
Predicting the future and overgeneralization, exaggerating fatigue consequences
Avoidance behavior toward early rising leading to Reduced socializing
Keeping Silence about the distress, not yet actively seeking friends' support

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding activities and plans involving weekend mornings
antecedent: Thinking about having to get up early as the weekend approaches
Receives early-morning gathering invitations/tasks from friends or event organizers
Worrying the night before the weekend about not sleeping well or being unable to Recover energy
target_behavior.core_reason: The maladaptive experience of the high-pressure photography event months ago and cognitive biases (catastrophizing, black-and-white, predicting the future) Reinforced the belief and Anxiety that 'early rising will ruin the weekend'
target_behavior.function: Escaping the anticipated discomfort and Anxiety, maintaining a sense of control over the weekend
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, declining weekend experience, Disrupted sleep patterns, persistent weekend-related Anxiety
